content.bridge_context: Learning how electricity flows and how we control it.

units.title: Components of a Circuit
units.dual_language_instruction: Draw the symbol for a battery. / बैटरी का प्रतीक बनाएं।

units.title: Conductors and Insulators
units.explanation: Conductors allow electricity to pass (metals). Insulators block it (plastic, wood).
units.dual_language_instruction: Identify an insulator in your house. / अपने घर में एक विसंवाहक (insulator) की पहचान करें।
